main_text.l: NVlla probatio potest esse vera Christianitatis, neque refugiu potest esse Christianorum aliud, volentium cognoscere fidei veritatem, nisi Scripturae diuinae.
VOLENS ergo quis cognoscere quae sit vera Ecclesia Christi, unde cognoscat in tanta confusionis similitudine, nisi tantummodo per Scripturas?

page.notes: The first letters N and V are large decorative initials. The word "refugiu" is printed as such. A woodcut ornament (a mask with foliage and drapery) stands below the text and is not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse page is present and was omitted.
